# healthchecks_project_member (Resource)

Manages project team membership through the project settings web form. Role updates are implemented as remove-and-reinvite because Healthchecks currently exposes invite/remove actions, not a dedicated role update endpoint.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `role` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
